intro.title: Two Sum
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that solves the classic 'Two Sum' problem, which involves finding two numbers in an array that add up to a specific target value. The core programming concept used is the hash map (or object in JavaScript), which allows for efficient lookups to avoid nested loops. You will work with fundamental JavaScript constructs like arrays, objects, for loops, and conditional logic. By the end, you'll understand how to implement an optimal O(n) solution and practice problem-solving with common data structures.
intro.usecase: The Two Sum algorithm is essential for real-time data validation and matching systems in production applications. For example, e-commerce platforms use it to verify that a user's selected product combinations match available inventory or promotional bundles before checkout. In financial dashboards, it helps identify pairs of transactions that sum to specific amounts for fraud detection. Developers implement this pattern in search filters, recommendation engines, and form validation where matching pairs of values must be identified instantly from large datasets.
